hero_description.en: In the public and non-profit sectors, effective decisions depend on understanding the people you serve — how they access information, use technology, and engage with media. The Media Technology Monitor provides trusted Canadian data that helps organizations design better programs, improve communications, and make evidence-based decisions with confidence.

usecases_description.en: Learn how the MTM offers reports and content that can inform decisions based on robust, tried and true survey results.

usecase_1_description.en: Bell used MTM's trending data to track the decline of traditional radio among 35–54 year olds — and reallocated their audio investment toward podcast and streaming audio before the shift hit their own listenership numbers.

usecase_1_cta.en: Track platform adoption curves for your core demographic to catch audience migration before it shows up in your internal data.

usecase_2_description.en: Rogers used MTM to size the bilingual sports audience across streaming and linear — identifying an underserved Francophone segment that became the basis for a new strategy.

usecase_2_cta.en: Cross-tab your content category against language market and platform data to find the audience gaps your current rights portfolio isn't reaching.

testimonial_title.en: What government and NGO partners are saying about us

testimonial_quote.en: Our decisions have to stand up to scrutiny — from where funding goes to how impact is measured. MTM's data gives us that credibility. It connects audience behaviour to real outcomes, helping us plan investments and policies that actually reflect how Canadians consume media today.
